title: 10-year Treasury yield hits 5% for first time since 2023 as traders brace for Fed decision this week
summary_full: The 10-year U.S. Treasury note yield rose to a multi-year high on Monday ahead of this week's Federal Reserve interest rate decision.
summary_public: The 10-year U.S. Treasury note yield rose to a multi-year high on Monday ahead of this week's Federal Reserve interest rate decision.
